scenes.text: Regular customer *2 mahine se* nahi aayi?
scenes.say: Salon owners. Regular customer do mahine se nahi aayi?

scenes.text: Wo bas *bhool gayi*. Aur paas wala salon *yaad dila* gaya.
scenes.say: Wo naraz nahi hai. Bas bhool gayi. Aur paas wala salon yaad dila gaya.

scenes.title: Har service ka *rebook timer*:
scenes.say: Har service ka ek timer hota hai. Haircut chaar-paanch hafte, facial chaar hafte, colour chhe hafte.

scenes.title: Timer pe ye *1 message*:
scenes.name: Your Salon

msgs.text: Hi Neha ✨ last haircut ko 5 hafte ho gaye. Is Saturday *11 am ya 4 pm* free hai, book karun?

scenes.say: Timer pe ek message, do slot ke saath. Haan ya na mein jawab aasaan.

scenes.text: Birthday month mein *1 free add-on*. Sabse zyaada reply isi pe aate hain.
scenes.say: Bonus. Birthday month mein ek free add-on.

scenes.text: Ye *register* se bhi ho sakta hai. Ya hum *auto* kar dein?
scenes.sub: Comment AUDIT: aapke salon ka free plan
scenes.say: Register se bhi kar sakte ho. Automatic chahiye to comment karo AUDIT. Ya seedha WhatsApp karo, hum aapke liye set kar denge.

caption:
Regular customer 2 mahine se nahi aayi? Wo naraz nahi, bas bhool gayi. Aur paas wala salon yaad dila gaya. 💇‍♀️

Business of the Day: Salon
Har service ka rebook timer:
✂️ Haircut: 4-5 hafte
✨ Facial/cleanup: 4 hafte
🎨 Colour/root touch-up: 6 hafte

Timer pe 1 WhatsApp: "Last haircut ko 5 hafte ho gaye. Saturday 11 am ya 4 pm?" Do slot do, jawab aasaan.
Bonus: birthday month mein 1 free add-on.

Comment "AUDIT" 👇 aapke salon ka free plan.

📲 Ye problem aapke business mein bhi hai? WhatsApp karo: 98131 36114, hum set kar denge.
